description: PAID ($0.0018 USDC via x402). Forecast for any coordinate from MET Norway's Locationforecast 2.0 (global): the current hour (temperature, humidity, wind, cloud, next-hour rain, symbol), rows up to `hours` ahead (1 h steps ~2.5 days, then 6 h, each stating its period), and up to 9 UTC-day rows with min/max (incl. MET's 6-hour extremes), total precipitation and the main condition. Times UTC; MET's CC BY 4.0 attribution included. No air quality or alerts. Upstream failure is not charged. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

days.description: How many daily summary rows (UTC calendar days, today first), 1-9 (default 3)

hours.description: How many hours ahead the `hourly` rows reach, 1-72 (default 24). Steps are 1 h for about the first 2.5 days and 6 h after

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, -90 to 90 (required with lon; an empty body answers the published example point)

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, -180 to 180 (required with lat)

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.

name: weather_forecast

asOf.description: ISO time the forecast was read from MET (or revalidated as unchanged)

attribution.description: The credit MET Norway's licence (CC BY 4.0 / NLOD 2.0) requires — keep it beside any use of the data

current.description: The forecast for the hour now falls in (a forecast, not an observation)

daily.description: One row per UTC day, today first: min/max temperature, total precipitation, main condition

hoursCovered.description: Hours of this UTC day the forecast covers (the first day starts now)

precipitationMm.description: Total over the covered hours; null if a period had no amount

symbol.description: The condition covering the most hours, without its _day/_night variant

defaulted.description: Present only when the body was empty: which point the answer is for, and why

forecastEndsAt.description: The last forecast time MET publishes for this point (about 9-10 days ahead)

hourly.description: Forecast rows from now for `hours` hours: 1-hour steps for about 2.5 days, then 6-hour steps

periodHours.description: 1 or 6: the period precipitationMm and symbol cover; null when MET gives none for this row

precipitationMm.description: Precipitation over the next periodHours hours

symbol.description: MET weather symbol code for the period, e.g. partlycloudy_day

location.description: The point forecast (rounded to 4 decimals) and its elevation above sea level as MET models it

modelUpdatedAt.description: When MET last updated this forecast (meta.updated_at)

note.description: How to read the rows (UTC times, step lengths, daily rules) and their limits

title: Weather forecast for any point (MET Norway, 9 days) ($0.0018)
